# Release Notes: Disruption January 23, 2026 The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience on the Disruption platform. ## New Feature ### Bulk File Deletion The Delete option is now enabled for bulk removal of files on both the **Processing Files** and **Utilization Files** pages. Users can multi select files using checkboxes. To select all files on the current page, use the **Select All** checkbox; to clear selections, use the **Deselect All** or **Delete Selected** button. #### Confirmation Before Bulk Deletion When multiple eligible files are selected for deletion, a confirmation dialog appears. It displays the total number of files selected and warns that the deletion action is irreversible. #### Errors During Deletion If any files fail to delete due to server errors or permission issues, an alert message appears listing the files that could not be successfully deleted. #### Note: The Delete option is disabled when no files are selected on the **Processing Files** or **Utilization Files** pages. ## Enhancements ### Tool tip message When a user does not have permission to delete an analysis, the checkbox in the bulk delete workflow is disabled. Hovering over the disabled checkbox now displays a tooltip explaining the reason. ### Summary Overview tab Utilization File and Total Providers details are displayed above the graph and are removed from the table. Added a hyperlink for Utilization File under **Show Analysis Criteria**. Replaced the **View** selection dropdown with radio buttons (Confidence, INN/OON) and adjusted the graph size to best fit the page layout.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/23jan26releasenotesimg.png)
### Tooltips When Using Keyboard Navigation Across Multiple Pages Enabled tooltip info icons in the Providers tab (Claims/Amount Paid), Matching Configuration (view/edit/create), and Utilization Files (edit/import) for keyboard navigation using the Tab key, ensuring these pages meet accessibility requirements. ## Fixes ### Empty Utilization File Import Fixed an issue with uploading empty Utilization file leading to computing quality scores failure after mapping. Uploading Utilization file with some random characters without any data or only column headings and no other data will be rejected at validation state only. ### Disable Delete Button from Vertical Ellipse Menu For Client Admin users, the delete option in the vertical ellipse (three dot) menu is disabled for any matching configuration that cannot be removed, either because it is part of an active analysis or the user does not have delete permissions.
